title: Battle of Sacheon (1598)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sacheon (1598)", at revision 1370587918, opens: "The Battle of Sacheon (泗川) was a siege by Korean and Chinese forces against the Japanese fortification of Sacheon from 28 to 29 September 1598, during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's invasions of Korea." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q484475, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Korean and Chinese siege against Japanese in 1598". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
